content: Onasemalimali tolelewana manuna
Muliyega wate Yesu ꞌiila limana Galili leꞌawinaya sabi loguguya ta boda sinabwana siegogona ꞌenaya, ꞌenega ꞌebweu waga ꞌidoedoe ꞌenaya ꞌigelu ga ꞌimiyatowa, ta pwalu leꞌawaya sitootoolo.
Ta Yesu onasemalimali yauna ꞌediyega ꞌieꞌita tomota ꞌediya, ꞌigwaegwae,
“Wanono! Tobagula ꞌebweu ꞌina bagulaya ꞌitauya ga witi atuna ꞌilelewanedi,
ga ꞌaina atu nidi ꞌedaya sibeꞌu, ꞌenega manuwa siꞌitedi ta simwaꞌuta ga siꞌenidi.
Ta ꞌaina sibeꞌu bwaꞌa logulegulewana ꞌenaya ga sitabwa manini, manuna bwaꞌa gidalina tuga,
ꞌenega ala ꞌitudimwedi ga siꞌoapelu, manuna lamudi nigeya bwaꞌa gonituna silobaloba.
Ta ꞌaina kwakwakwala ꞌediya sibeꞌu ga sitabwa enoenowa, ta nigeya kapekapeyana be siuuwa, manuna kwakwakwala ꞌiewaiwai ga ꞌididiemwawasidi.
Ta ꞌaina atu bwaꞌa boboꞌana ꞌenaya sibeꞌu ga sitabwa ta sisinabwa ga siuwa, ga ꞌaina teti, be sikisiti, be analedi.”
Ga Yesu ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “ꞌEguma matenami ona gete wada nono.”
Onasemalimali ꞌina apwesas ꞌalena
Muliyega pwalu sidelisawala ga Yesu taunamo, ga ꞌaina tomota ta ꞌina tononoyao site tuwelo maꞌediyao simai ga Yesu ꞌena sienaida, sigwae, “ꞌImu onasemalimali nidi toꞌase ꞌadi mwalatoi?”
Ta Yesu ꞌigwae, “ꞌOmi niꞌatu Yaubada ꞌemiya ꞌiꞌebwaya be ꞌina loina solaꞌaiꞌailidi ꞌana tomwalatoiyao, ta esi tomota yaudi nuwa potapotadi ga onasemalimali sinono,

ta ꞌana nuwasabwalena nigeya simwalamwalatoni, ta wate ꞌana mwalatoi siꞌebeꞌebese ta nigeya sawesawenaya siloba. ꞌEnega wate nigeya sawesawenaya ꞌidi loegesiyao ꞌediyega sinuwanuwaꞌebuni, be geyaꞌabo Yaubada ꞌinuwanuwataudi.”
Onasemalimali tolelewana manuna ꞌana liꞌama
ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Mwaꞌadega ꞌigu onasemalimali gete nigeya wanuwanuwa sabwaleni, aga? Be mwaꞌadega ꞌaina onasemalimali gete nadigega wada nuwasabwalenidi?
“Tobagula nina Yaubada ꞌina ona ꞌilelewanena.
ꞌAidi atu sibeꞌu ꞌedaya, ꞌatuwa nadigega tomotai Yaubada ꞌina ona sinonona, ta ꞌenega Seitani ꞌimai ga ona nina ꞌediyega ꞌiꞌewa yauledi.
“Wate nadigega atu nidi bwaꞌa logulegulewana ꞌenaya sibeꞌubeꞌu, ꞌaene ꞌabo tomota nidi Yaubada ꞌina ona sinonoi ta ma idi gwausowala sitatagwala,
ta nigeya lamudi ꞌipaꞌapaꞌala, ꞌenega tuta gidalina namo ꞌenaya sida miyami, be ꞌabo to tuta ꞌenaya Yaubada ꞌina ona ꞌana emisa manuna mwau nai etalauwala silobai, sibeꞌu manini.
“Ta atu nidi kwakwakwala ꞌediya sibeꞌuya ꞌatuwa tomota nidi taudi Yaubada ꞌina ona sinonona,
ta esaesa be baleꞌu ꞌina yageyao ꞌadi nuwanuwa ꞌediyega Yaubada ꞌina ona sinuwa pupulena, ꞌenega nigeya sawesawenaya be siuuwa.

“Ta atu nidi bwaꞌa boboꞌana ꞌena sibeꞌuya ꞌatuwa tomota nidi taudi ma idi ꞌatetagwala Yaubada ꞌina ona sinonona, ꞌenega uwadi boboꞌana ta yauna siuwaedi. ꞌAina uwadiyao teti, ta ꞌaina sikisiti, ta ꞌaina analedi.”
Onasemalimali mayale manuna
Ta Yesu wate ꞌediya ꞌigwae, “Geyaꞌabo mayale loeloeꞌabina tasaꞌusaꞌu kwaiye ꞌule nai sita ꞌediyega, ta esi ꞌatamanaya tasaꞌu be ꞌimaedana,
be ꞌenega yage nidi kwaikwaiyidi maꞌetamo maedana nina ꞌigieapwesedi be taꞌitadi.
ꞌEguma matenami ona gete wada nono.”
Ta wate ꞌieonedi, “Wada nuwaꞌiꞌisi be ona wada nono ꞌaiꞌailidi, manuna ꞌeguma ꞌomi toꞌase waꞌebwaya, wate nadigega ꞌana eꞌisa waꞌewa, ta esi ma ꞌana loeposeyana.
Manuna ꞌeguma yaita ꞌenaya Yaubada ꞌina gwegwe ꞌimiyami, gwegwe nina ꞌiloeposeyane. Ta yaita ꞌenaya nigeya Yaubada ꞌina gwegwe ꞌimiyami, toꞌase ꞌena ꞌimiyami Yaubada ꞌenega ꞌiꞌewa yauledi.”
Onasemalimali suwana manuna
Ga Yesu ꞌigwae, “Yaubada ꞌina loina tomota ꞌediya ꞌatuwa nadigega suwana tai ꞌina tanowaya ꞌiasodi,
ta tai nina ꞌiꞌeno be ꞌitoolo ꞌasiyata be boiboiya, ta suwana nidi sitabwatabwa, ta nigeya ꞌimwalamwalatoni mwaꞌadega sitabwatabwaꞌesa.
Manuna bwaꞌa ꞌiloina ꞌidi tabwa be ꞌidi sinabwa be ꞌidi uwa manuna,
be muliyega ꞌabo uwana ꞌimatuwa ꞌenega toni bagula nina ꞌieꞌale be ꞌisesoni.”
Onasemalimali beno atuna manuna
Yesu wate ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Mwaꞌadega Yaubada ꞌina loina onasemalimaliyega yada giemaedanaꞌese ꞌemiya?
Nai gete nadigega ꞌebweu kaiwe atuna ꞌenaya yada loesawaꞌiꞌi, nate beno, manuna beno atuna gidalina,
ta ꞌabo taasoi be ꞌitatabwa pwatula ꞌisinabwa sinedi, ta nalinao sinabwadi ꞌisaꞌudi, be nalinao yauyaukwidi ꞌediya manuwa ꞌidi newa siꞌabidi.”
Yesu ꞌina onasemalimali yauna
Yesu ꞌina loguguyao ꞌediya tuta yauna onasemalimali yauna ꞌediyega ꞌieꞌieꞌita, be ꞌenega ꞌabo tomota ꞌediya kapekapeyana sida mwalatoni.
Tauna tuta yauna onasemalimaliyega ꞌiloguloguguya pwalu ꞌediya, ta ꞌina tononoyao dimo ꞌediya onasemalimali nidi ꞌiliꞌaliꞌamidi.
Yesu yagila be lisu ꞌiloinedi
ꞌAsuinuwanuwaya Yesu ꞌina loguguya wagega ꞌilosalonina ga ꞌina tononoyao ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Wageluma be taabala mali esenaya.”
ꞌEnega sigelu ga sigiseyana ga pwalu leꞌawaya sipilisinedi, ta ꞌaidi waga wate maꞌenao,
ga wediliya sinabwana ꞌitowama, ta lisu wagaya ꞌisiwasiwaꞌoyaꞌa ga ꞌiabe sidadamana.
Ta Yesu waga kuliginaya ꞌana gedu ꞌisaꞌuna ga ꞌiꞌeno mwataya, ta ꞌina tononoyao silowanowanona ga sigwae, “ꞌInapwana ꞌutoolo be ꞌulemeda. ꞌIabe tamwamwawasa!”
ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌitoolo ga yagila be lisu ꞌibaꞌedi, ꞌigwae, “Tuwa! ꞌUꞌemutuyo be ꞌusiwalowa!” ꞌEnega yagila ꞌipela ga bwagabwaga maiboꞌana ꞌisiwalowa.
Ta ꞌina tononoyao ꞌediya ꞌigwae, “Toꞌase manuna wamatauta? Mwaꞌadega nigeya waemiemisegu?”
Ta nuwadi ꞌiowana ga simatauta, ta taudimo ꞌediya sigwae, “To tai sana gete ga yagila be lisu ꞌenana siematamatanena?”
